day_shape: Trump halts Iran talks and posts Hormuz-as-US-territory claim while Iran says Strait stays shut until sanctions lift; Israel confirms Syrian airbase strike, IDF returns SFC Katz remains after 44 years, Khamenei issues Persian Gulf Day message.

threads.label: Hormuz closure and stalled US-Iran track
threads.summary: Iran's Ghalibaf said the Strait of Hormuz will stay closed until Washington lifts sanctions and the marine blockade and frees frozen assets, while Trump said no talks with Tehran are scheduled and posted a Truth Social claim declaring Hormuz US territory. Reuters reported two Chinese state tankers are avoiding Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab, and Jerusalem Post reported shipowners are avoiding the waterway; Defa Press cited Brookings on a February 2026 Hormuz shock, and Khamenei's office issued a Persian Gulf Day message saying foreigners have 'no place except in the depths of its waters'.

threads.label: Iran regional posture and Iraq visit
threads.summary: Parliament Speaker Qalibaf departed Tehran for Baghdad leading a parliamentary delegation, saying Iran and Iraq would take 'major steps' on common security, while IRGC adviser Naqdi told Sputnik Iran's doctrine had turned offensive and Chief of Staff Abdollahi warned Gulf states against hosting US aircraft. Jerusalem Post reported Iran may have showcased a new drone in a strike on the Kurdistan Regional Government, and Iran denied responsibility for a Dubai missile attack, calling it a possible US-Israeli false flag.

threads.label: Israel strike on Syrian airbase
threads.summary: Netanyahu's office confirmed Israel struck a Syrian military airport overnight, saying Syria was about to breach a status quo by allowing Turkish deployment near Aleppo, and US envoy Tom Barrack said Washington was 'deeply concerned' and that a Israel-Syria-Turkey deconfliction mechanism was underway. Al-Hadath separately reported the IAEA discovered and collected nuclear material in Syria, with FM al-Shaibani saying it will remain under Damascus's control.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and Katz remains returned
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck Hamas Nukhba commanders meeting near Gaza City port, including a company commander and three platoon commanders, with Palestinian media reporting six killed at a cafe, and announced the killing of Islamic Jihad commander Tareq Anwar Khamis Ra'i in Khan Younis. Israel also announced that the remains of SFC Yehuda Katz, missing since the 1982 battle of Sultan Yacoub, were recovered in a joint IDF-Mossad operation in Lebanon.

threads.label: European and North American Iran actions
threads.summary: French FM Barrot expelled two Iranian diplomats, which Defa Press called 'unjustified' and a French source told Iran International Tehran's espionage allegations against detained French diplomats were 'completely false'. The US DOJ updated charges against 17 Mabna Institute individuals accused of IRGC-linked hacking; Canada deported a former Iranian Interior Ministry spokesman tied to the 2019 crackdown; and the Pentagon ordered 30 US universities including Harvard, MIT and UC Berkeley to audit research ties with Iran, China and Russia.

threads.label: US regional diplomacy and force posture
threads.summary: Secretary Rubio spoke with UAE NSA Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed on regional security including Lebanon, while Jerusalem Post reported the US may downscale its Middle East presence following damage from Iranian attacks and that Washington is shortening its annual drill with Seoul from 11 to five days, with South Korea's FM linking the move to US pressure over Iran. Lebanese President Aoun told lawmakers extending UNIFIL's mandate is Lebanon's 'first option', and Jared Kushner warned Hamas the US could back Israel to 'finish the job' if disarmament commitments are broken.

threads.label: Iran domestic protest and Basij anxiety
threads.summary: Iran International reported security forces detained three relatives of Kian Pirfalak, the nine-year-old killed in 2022 protests, in Izeh, and published a leaked audio in which Basij officials weigh the risk of new protests and fear online identification. Separate Iran International pieces described Iranian journalists' extended exile and life seven months after the January massacre, while Khamenei's office announced fortieth-day commemoration ceremonies for the 'Martyred Leader of Iran' in Tehran, Qom and Mashhad.

events.title_en: Hormuz; where Iran displayed its power to America
events.summary_en: Hormuz; where Iran displayed its power to America. The Strait of Hormuz is no longer just a strategic waterway; it has become a scene where Iran has been able to display one of its most important levers of power against America. The recent tweet of the secretary of the Supreme National Security Council touched precisely on this reality. Mohsen Rezaei, referring to the 7,000-mile distance from Washington to the Strait of Hormuz, emphasised that the gap between America's inability to reopen the strait and its claim of ownership is even greater than this geographical distance. He concluded by speaking of a 'post-American order in the Persian Gulf'; a phrase that in current circumstances carries a strategic message beyond mere political slogan.

events.summary_en: Forecast of scattered rainfall in northern highlands by Meteorological Organisation: Scattered rainfall is forecast today and tomorrow in the highlands of Gilan, Mazandran and Golestan. Concurrently, in the afternoon and evening hours, southern Sistan and Baluchistan, Kerman and Hormozgan highlands will witness heavy showers, thunderstorms and strong temporary winds. In some areas of the southwest, east and northeast of the country, strong temporary winds, dust and reduced air quality are expected. The Caspian Sea, Persian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz and Oman Sea will be rough until Friday.

events.title_en: Brookings Institution: America the big loser in Hormuz shock
events.summary_en: Brookings Institution: America the big loser in Hormuz shock. The Hormuz Strait shock following the US and Israeli attack on Iran in February 2026 created the largest disruption in global oil and gas supply. America increased its oil and gas production, while China sharply reduced oil imports and increased clean technology exports. China overcame this crisis by relying on coal, strategic oil reserves, increased imports from Russia and electric vehicles. America only profits from short-term increase in demand for fossil fuels, but China benefits from both the current crisis and the gradual transition to clean energy. China's dominance in clean technology production (solar panels).

events.title: After 44 years, the remains of SFC Yehuda Yekutiel Katz have been brought to Israel In an operation led by the Intelligence Directorate and through a joint intelligence effort with the Mossad, the remains of Yehuda were located and brought to Israel. This marks a long-awaited conclusion of the search efforts and follows previous operations in which SFC Zachary Baumel was returned to Israel in 2019 and SFC Tzvika Feldman was returned in 2025, thereby completing the mission to return all of the missing soldiers from the Battle of Sultan Yacoub.
events.summary:

The army says that it took steps to minimize the harm to civilians in the strike.
